items.titulo: Google November 2026 Core Update Is Rolling Out
items.resumen: Google officially announced the rollout of the November 2026 core update just now, on Tuesday at around 1:07 pm ET. This core update is expected to take about 2 weeks to roll out. Google said, "This is a regular update designed to better surface relevant, satisfying content for searchers from all types of sites."

items.titulo: Google Loses Another Round in Legal Battle Against SerpApi Over Scraping
items.resumen: Google has lost again in SerpApi's scraping legal fight in court, with the court giving Google 21 days to amend its complaint. But this is a major win for SerpApi and this case seems like it might be coming to a close soon.
